# review-annotations

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-001 — A reviewer reads review threads on the text, and unplaceable ones are kept](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-001.md) — When a document has a review comments file next to it, the Studio SHALL highlight the quoted text of each thread in the preview, open the thread when the reviewer selects the highlight, and list a thread whose text can no longer be found with confidence among the orphaned comments, keeping it in the file.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-003 — A reviewer comments, replies, resolves and deletes, and no comment is lost](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-003.md) — When a reviewer selects text in the preview and saves a comment, or replies to, resolves, reopens or deletes a thread, the Studio SHALL save that change in the review comments file under the name of its author, keep every change saved in quick succession, and, when a change cannot be saved, keep the typed text on screen and tell the reviewer why.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-008 — Review threads follow edits and renames of the document](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-008.md) — When the text of a document changes or the document is renamed or moved, the Studio SHALL keep each review thread on the text it quotes and move the review comments file along with the document.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-012 — A writer sees HTML comments and TODO notes as chips and toggles them](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-012.md) — When a document holds an HTML comment or the word TODO, the Studio SHALL show it as a small chip that opens into a box with the comment text, let the writer hide the gray comment chips while the TODO chips stay, and toggle a TODO comment around the current or selected lines from the keyboard in a block editor.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-015 — A writer keeps a discussion in the Markdown source and answers it from the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-015.md) — When a document holds an inline thread comment, the Studio SHALL show it as a thread chip that opens into its messages and lets the writer reply to it or delete it, and refuse a reply or a deletion while an edit is open, telling the writer to save or cancel the edit first.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-017 — A writer sees which blocks changed since the last commit](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-017.md) — When a file tracked by Git differs from its last commit, the Studio SHALL mark each changed block of the preview with a green bar, and stop showing the bars when the writer hides the changes.
